Problem Statement:
Write a Java program to calculate the average value of array elements. 
Input Description:
The program should accept an integer N (size of the array).
The next N integers represent the elements of the array. 
Output Description:
The program should print the average value of the array elements as a floating-point number. 
Sample Input:
5
1 2 3 4 5 
Sample Output:
3.0
